name: chart-library
description: Free market-state research through three read-only tools: market_state, daily_note, and research_quality.
long_description: Read a completed-session market state, historical analogs and outcome ranges in one call. Or read the published daily research and its settled-note tally, or the dated calibration receipt. No API key is required to try. Historical excess ranges are empirical observations, not automatically calibrated forecasts; calibration applies only to the method and population named in the receipt. Existing advanced tool names remain callable. For custom integrations, contact graham@chartlibrary.io.

CHART_LIBRARY_API_KEY.title: Chart Library API Key
CHART_LIBRARY_API_KEY.description: Optional. Public research works without a key. Service limits and data terms apply.
